# 00000003063

**English.** Definition: Nonlocal integrability: the spectrum of nonlocal conservation laws. Conjecture: The hierarchy of nonlocal laws: nonlocal conservation laws are generated by the negative-power expansion of the recursion operator, with coefficients of the expansion the inverse-scattering recursion of nonlocal densities. (nonlocal negative-power expansion recursion)

**中文。** 定义：非局域可积性：非局域守恒律的谱。猜想：非局域律的层级：非局域守恒律的生成为递推算子的负幂展开且展开的系数为非局域密度的反散射递推。（非局域负幂展开递推）
